title: The Security For WooCommerce WordPress plugin through 1.0.16 does not check that the requester is authorised before…
description: The Security For WooCommerce WordPress plugin up to version 1.0.16 contains a vulnerability where it does not verify if the requester is authorized before executing certain comment cleanup actions. This flaw allows unauthenticated users to permanently delete all comments on the site, including approved comments and WooCommerce order notes.
